dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: We've also taken up some of the setup work for this Irodori Festival here at Sailing Breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Not only that, we've also gotten ourselves a collaboration with the light novel "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?". We'll be selling a limited number of collaborative drinks every day!

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: The drink has some products from Mondstadt in it and tastes very unique as a result. Do come and give it a go.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: We've also taken up some of the setup work for this Irodori Festival here at Sailing Breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Not only that, we've also gotten ourselves a collaboration with the light novel "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?". We'll start selling it once the festival opens, so please wait patiently!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you selling now?

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Our collaboration event-exclusive drinks will only be available during the Irodori Festival, and every customer is only entitled to one cup.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About this shop...

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: This shop is the exclusive seller of fine liquor from Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Our ciders are all brewed from the purest water of Cider Lake and the freshest fruits from Mondstadt. We make sure that even here in Inazuma, our customers shall have the finest and the most authentic Mondstadt drinks!

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: So if you choose the finest liquor from Mondstadt, choose Sailing Breeze!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's business going?

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: It's been pretty good these few days. I'd even call myself a bit in over my head!

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Lots of guests from Mondstadt have made their way over recently, and they always come here to buy wine, so our sales of Mondstadt wines have also been on the up and up.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Hey, how about trying some fine wine from Mondstadt? It's the real deal, authenticity guaranteed!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Goodbye! See you next time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's business been?

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: It's not bad. After all, liquor from Mondstadt is the best in Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: But the Sakoku Decree has really created some difficulty in the transportation of supplies. That's a headache...

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: I have no idea what will happen if we use local ingredients. Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would your liquor be better than Dawn Winery's?

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Well, I'm sure we'd...

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Ah, never mind. As a drinker myself, I can't go against my conscience in this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: I have to admit that Dawn Winery's drinks are better. Even I prefer them.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Our store was actually forced to sell liquor here because we couldn't compete against Angel's Share.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: But the businesses under Dawn Winery have practically monopolized the liquor industry in Mondstadt. I... don't really think that's a good thing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you only sell liquor?

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Um, too young to drink, are you? Well, we do sell other stuff too, like Mondstadt's famous Dandelion Wine's... brewing ingredients!

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: That's a Mondstadt specialty. It's not supposed to be in the inventory list. But since you're also an outlander like me, I will make an exception and sell you those.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's business been?

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: It's not bad. After all, liquor from Mondstadt is the best in Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: The moment the Sakoku Decree ended, I had clients coming up to me to place some orders. And what do you know — Mondstadt's Dandelion Wine was number one on the list!

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Now that the thunderstorm surrounding Inazuma has dispersed, cargo-carrying ships should be able to get here quickly. Once that happens, never mind our clientele... I'll be able to get a good drink myself.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: *cough* I mean, after work, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Huh... How can this be? Did I make a mistake somewhere?

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Hehe, another one down. It's a hard game. It's only natural that you weren't able to overcome me.
